schedule: Every Sunday, 7:30 am from the Incycle Pasadena parking lot. Two groups.

start_location.name: Incycle Pasadena shop parking lot

pace: Group 1: intermediate, 35-45 miles, a true no-drop ride. Group 2: for riders who like a challenge, with a lot of climbing and plenty of regrouping. No sprinting or breaking away
visitor_notes: The shop's Strava club description is the only listing found: the club has no dated ride posts, so check with the shop before a first visit. The group follows all traffic laws and gives pedestrians the right of way.
description: A Sunday-morning shop ride that rolls from the Incycle Pasadena parking lot at 7:30 am. The club calls it a no-drop ride for everyone. The first group is for intermediate riders who want 35 to 45 miles; the second is for riders who like climbing, with a lot of climbing and plenty of regrouping.

name: Sports Basement Long Beach Group Ride
schedule: 2nd and 4th Saturday of every month: meet 7:30 am for donuts and coffee, wheels roll at 8:00 am sharp, from Sports Basement Long Beach.

start_location.name: Sports Basement Long Beach
start_location.address: 2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

pace: road ride, about 16 mph overall (17-18 mph moving); special rides run longer
cost: free; sign the in-store waiver the first time
visitor_notes: Bring a repair kit, water and food. An approved helmet is required and fixed-gear bikes are not allowed. Riders must be 18 or ride with a parent or guardian. Some dates are replaced: there was no ride on July 25, and Sept 26 was a 45-mile Turnbull Canyon out-and-back with a 7:00 meet and 7:30 roll. Bike Long Beach's calendar lists an 8:00 meet and an 8:15 to 8:30 roll; the group's own posts say 7:30 and 8:00.
description: The Long Beach Sports Basement hosts a no-drop road ride on the second and fourth Saturdays. Riders gather at 7:30 for donuts and coffee and roll at 8:00, usually 28 to 30 miles at about 16 mph overall. Special rides can run longer, like September 26's 45-mile trip to Turnbull Canyon. Snacks, drinks and a store discount after.
evidence: The Sports Basement Long Beach Ride Group's Strava club page says the group meets the 2nd and 4th Saturday at 7:30 am and rolls at 8:00 am, and carries posts dated Sept 10 and Sept 20, 2026 for the Sept 12 and Sept 26 rides (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club posts each ride a few days ahead. Bike Long Beach's public calendar also lists the 2nd and 4th Saturdays, with different times.

name: SunDazies Sunday Ride (FTWNB Cycling Collective)
schedule: About one Sunday morning a month, for femme, trans, women and nonbinary riders. Sept 27 rolled at 8:00 am from Sports Basement Long Beach. Next: Oct 25, a witch-themed ride; time and start are on the club's Strava page.

start_location.name: Varies by ride. Sept 27 started at Sports Basement Long Beach
start_location.address: 2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

pace: casual zone 2 pace (the club asks for no race pace), with regroups
visitor_notes: These rides are for femme, trans, women and nonbinary riders. The club says it is important to keep the space for FTWNB folks only, even though it has male supporters. Helmets are required. Some rides ask for an RSVP (link in the club's bio) so there are enough drinks and snacks. Meet times have been 8:00 to 9:00 am.
description: SunDazies is a Long Beach cycling collective for femme, trans, women and nonbinary riders, about 300 members on Strava. It rides on Sunday mornings about once a month, from introductory rides that blend new and experienced riders to casual zone 2 training rides like Sept 27's trip down the San Gabriel River toward Seal Beach. Next up is a witch-themed ride on Oct 25.
evidence: SunDazies' Strava event page lists the SunDazies x Sports Basement ride for Sun Sept 27, 2026 at 8:00 am and says to mark Oct 25 for a witch-themed ride, and the club page shows 2026 posts through Aug 4 (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Public club page with recent posts; each ride is a Strava group event with its own page.

name: Lightning Velo Sunday Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 8:00 am from the lot at 6460 E Marina Dr (temporary start while Studebaker Rd is under construction). Most rides end at The Crema Cafe on Main St in Seal Beach.

start_location.name: Marina Dr parking lot (temporary start during Studebaker Rd construction; the Sunday farmers' market can crowd the north end)
start_location.address: 6460 E Marina Dr, Long Beach, CA 90803

pace: A 23+ mph (might drop slow riders); B 19-22 mph and C 15-18 mph in no-drop double pacelines; D 10-15 mph, developmental
visitor_notes: D group and new riders should speak up when the group gathers: the D ride is tailored to whoever shows up. Seven A/B routes and six C routes rotate week by week. The club's site has a Ride Waiver page.
description: Lightning Velo is a Long Beach road club that started in 1988 as a racing club. On Sundays it rolls at 8:00 am in four groups: A is 23+ mph and may drop slow riders, B and C ride no-drop double pacelines, and D is for newer road riders. The A and B routes rotate through seven loops and the C through six. Most rides end at The Crema Cafe in Seal Beach.
evidence: Lightning Velo's home page lists the 8:00AM Sunday ride with its A to D groups, says that since May 10, 2026 all rides start from 6460 E Marina Dr, and carries a 2026 footer (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The home page lists each day's ride under 'Find Your Day' and carries the start-location notice. The Meetup feed lists the Saturday C-group rides only.

description: A weekday-morning ride on the San Gabriel River Trail: 33 miles for all riders, with a pit stop at PTF (Potty Too Far) at PCH and Orange St in Newport Beach, and a finish at The Crema Cafe on Main Street in Seal Beach. Lightning Velo runs it on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8:00 am.
